title: Noir week, ii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Tuesday. Captions, not balloons. A woman in a doorway who is not Chloe and is. A cigarette he doesn't smoke. The dog is still gone.

panels.composition: Main street at night, rain, a doorway lit from inside. A WOMAN in the doorway in a belted coat, face half in shadow. The TRENCH COAT in the street.

characters.pose: in a belted coat, doorway, half shadow

panels.caption: She was standing where she always stood. Which was wherever I wasn't.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a rain-slick small-town street at night with a woman in a belted coat standing in a lit doorway half in shadow and a man in a trench coat in the street, film-noir composition, heavy black
image.notes: Captions in a typewriter face, lettered after. No balloons all week.

panels.composition: The man's hand with a cigarette, unlit. He doesn't smoke. The strip knows.
panels.caption: I didn't smoke. It was that kind of week.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a man's hand in a trench-coat sleeve holding an unlit cigarette in rain

panels.composition: The woman turning back inside. The door closing. The light narrowing to a line.
panels.caption: She didn't say anything. She'd said it all in a letter I'd used as a coaster.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a woman turning back into a doorway as the door closes and the light narrows to a line, a man in a trench coat watching from the rain

panels.composition: The street. The man. The rain. Where the dog would walk into the panel: rain.
panels.caption: The street was empty. Even the things that were usually there weren't.
